text_block_list.text:
With all the races concluded, we set aside 
time to reflect on her record once again.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Compared to my debut, it feels like a 
heavy weight has settled upon my head.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, you have grasped it. The majesty 
you strived for as "Emperor"...!
choice_data_list: There's no one who doubts you anymore.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah... For that very reason, I sought the 
crown.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh... It seems you've settled in to 
shower me with praise today.
choice_data_list: Let me celebrate as much as I want.
Let me celebrate as much as I want.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Then I, too, shall savor this to my 
heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Just for today, I'll allow myself to be 
honest and immerse myself in pure joy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“—I'm expecting great things from you, 
Trainer-kun!”
